              (∃ b, ∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell), b i = Chevalley.e y v ↑i) ∧
                (∀ (t : ℕ), ell.toNat < t → (y ^ t) v = 0) ∧
                  Chevalley.stringActions ell x y h (Chevalley.e y v) ∧
                    Chevalley.dividedActions ell (Chevalley.dp x) (Chevalley.dp y) (Chevalley.e y v) →

                              Chevalley.mu p M
                                  ((LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Chevalley.R p)) (Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp y r)))
                                    u) =
                                (Chevalley.dp y r) (Chevalley.mu p M u)) ∧

  ∀ (Φ : Chevalley.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[Chevalley.R p] Chevalley.MR p M)),
  (∀ (c : K) (m : M), Φ (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[Chevalley.R p] ((1 : Chevalley.R p) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) →
  ∀ (F : Module.End ℤ M) (w : Chevalley.VK K M),
  Φ (F.baseChange K w) = ((F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p)).baseChange K) (Φ w)

arguments.statement:
∀ (ρ : Chevalley.R p →+* K),
  letI := ρ.toAlgebra
  ∀ (Φ : Chevalley.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[Chevalley.R p] Chevalley.MR p M)),
  (∀ (c : K) (m : M), Φ (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[Chevalley.R p] ((1 : Chevalley.R p) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) →
  ∀ (F : Module.End ℤ M) (u w : Chevalley.MR p M) (z : ℤ),
  (F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p)) u = z • w →
  F.baseChange K (Φ.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[Chevalley.R p] u)) = (z : K) • Φ.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[Chevalley.R p] w)
arguments.proof:
intro ρ
letI := ρ.toAlgebra
intro Φ hΦ F u w z heq
apply Φ.injective
rw [@yui_aux_0003 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_T004 h_T006 h_T012 h_T013 ρ Φ hΦ]
simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, heq,
  map_smul, TensorProduct.tmul_zsmul, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]

                ∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < t → x ((y ^ t) v) = (↑t * (↑ell - ↑t + 1)) • (y ^ (t - 1)) v) ∧
              (∃ b, ∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell), b i = Chevalley.e y v ↑i) ∧
                (∀ (t : ℕ), ell.toNat < t → (y ^ t) v = 0) ∧
                  Chevalley.stringActions ell x y h (Chevalley.e y v) ∧
                    Chevalley.dividedActions ell (Chevalley.dp x) (Chevalley.dp y) (Chevalley.e y v) →
      (((∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ Chevalley.R p ↔ ∃ a b, ¬↑p ∣ b ∧ q = ↑a / ↑b) ∧

  Chevalley.mu p M (F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p) u) = (z : ℂ) • Chevalley.mu p M w →

intro ρ
letI := ρ.toAlgebra
intro Φ hΦ F u w z heq

∀ β : Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) K (Chevalley.VK K M),
 (∀ (F : Module.End ℤ M) (f : Module.End ℂ V),
 (∀ u : Chevalley.MR p M, Chevalley.mu p M (F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p) u) = f (Chevalley.mu p M u)) →
 ∀ (i j : Chevalley.Index ell) (z : ℤ),
 f (Chevalley.e y v i.val) = (z : ℂ) • Chevalley.e y v j.val →
 F.baseChange K (β i) = (z : K) • β j) → ∀ i j : Chevalley.Index ell, (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧ Chevalley.matrixK K ell M x y i j = Chevalley.unitOp β i j
arguments.proof:
classical
intro β tr i j
obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h_T004.2.2.2.2.1
have hunit := (h_T006.2 b hb i j).1
have hnC : (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  simpa only [map_natCast] using (hunit.map (algebraMap (Chevalley.R p) ℂ)).ne_zero
have hnK : (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hc, ρ, hρ, hrest⟩ := h_T013
  simpa only [map_natCast] using (hunit.map ρ).ne_zero
refine ⟨hnK, ?_⟩
let F : Module.End ℤ M :=
  Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat - i.val)) *
    (Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat) * Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat)) *
      Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat - j.val))
let f : Module.End ℂ V :=
  Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat - i.val) *
    (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat) *
      Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat - j.val)
have hdx := fun r u => (h_T006.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 r u).1
have hdy := fun r u => (h_T006.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 r u).2
have hinter : ∀ u : Chevalley.MR p M,
    Chevalley.mu p M (F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p) u) = f (Chevalley.mu p M u) := by
  intro u
  simp only [F, f, LinearMap.baseChange_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hdx, hdy]
have hmat : f = (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : ℂ) • Chevalley.unitOp b i j := by
  rw [(h_T006.2 b hb i j).2.2.2.2.1, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hnC, one_smul]
have hFK : F.baseChange K = (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : K) • Chevalley.unitOp β i j := by
  apply β.ext
  intro k
  by_cases hk : k = j
  · subst k
    have he : f (Chevalley.e y v j.val) = ((Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : ℕ) : ℤ) • (Chevalley.e y v i.val) := by
      rw [← hb j, ← hb i, hmat]
      simp [Chevalley.unitOp, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
    have ht := tr F f hinter j i ((Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : ℕ) : ℤ) (by simpa [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul] using he)
    simpa [Chevalley.unitOp] using ht
  · have he : f (Chevalley.e y v k.val) = (0 : ℂ) • Chevalley.e y v i.val := by

have he : (((r.factorial : ℤ) • Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp f r))).baseChange K =

  apply @yui_aux_0008 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_T004 h_T006 h_T012 h_T013

  change (Chevalley.muR p M) ((r.factorial : ℤ) • _) = _

  rw [hd, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℂ]

    @yui_aux_0011 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_T004 h_T006 h_T012 h_T013, Chevalley.opK] using he

result.statement:
∀ β : Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) K (Chevalley.VK K M),
 (∀ (F : Module.End ℤ M) (f : Module.End ℂ V),
 (∀ u : Chevalley.MR p M, Chevalley.mu p M (F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p) u) = f (Chevalley.mu p M u)) →
 ∀ (i j : Chevalley.Index ell) (z : ℤ),
 f (Chevalley.e y v i.val) = (z : ℂ) • Chevalley.e y v j.val →
 F.baseChange K (β i) = (z : K) • β j) → ∀ i j : Chevalley.Index ell, (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧ Chevalley.matrixK K ell M x y i j = Chevalley.unitOp β i j
result.proof:
classical
intro β tr i j
obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h_T004.2.2.2.2.1
have hunit := (h_T006.2 b hb i j).1
have hnC : (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  simpa only [map_natCast] using (hunit.map (algebraMap (Chevalley.R p) ℂ)).ne_zero
have hnK : (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hc, ρ, hρ, hrest⟩ := h_T013
  simpa only [map_natCast] using (hunit.map ρ).ne_zero
refine ⟨hnK, ?_⟩
let F : Module.End ℤ M :=
  Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat - i.val)) *
    (Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat) * Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat)) *
      Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat - j.val))
let f : Module.End ℂ V :=
  Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat - i.val) *
    (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat) *
      Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat - j.val)
have hdx := fun r u => (h_T006.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 r u).1
have hdy := fun r u => (h_T006.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 r u).2
have hinter : ∀ u : Chevalley.MR p M,
    Chevalley.mu p M (F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p) u) = f (Chevalley.mu p M u) := by
  intro u
  simp only [F, f, LinearMap.baseChange_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hdx, hdy]
have hmat : f = (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : ℂ) • Chevalley.unitOp b i j := by
  rw [(h_T006.2 b hb i j).2.2.2.2.1, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hnC, one_smul]
have hFK : F.baseChange K = (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : K) • Chevalley.unitOp β i j := by
  apply β.ext
  intro k
  by_cases hk : k = j
  · subst k
    have he : f (Chevalley.e y v j.val) = ((Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : ℕ) : ℤ) • (Chevalley.e y v i.val) := by
      rw [← hb j, ← hb i, hmat]
      simp [Chevalley.unitOp, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
    have ht := tr F f hinter j i ((Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : ℕ) : ℤ) (by simpa [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul] using he)
    simpa [Chevalley.unitOp] using ht
  · have he : f (Chevalley.e y v k.val) = (0 : ℂ) • Chevalley.e y v i.val := by
      rw [← hb k, hmat]
      simp [Chevalley.unitOp, hk]
    have ht := tr F f hinter k i 0 he
    simpa [Chevalley.unitOp, hk] using ht
change (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : K)⁻¹ •
    (Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat-i.val)) *
      (Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat) * Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat)) *
        Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat-j.val))) = _
have hprod : Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat-i.val)) *
      (Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat) * Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat)) *
        Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat-j.val)) = F.baseChange K := by
  simp only [F, Chevalley.opK, LinearMap.baseChange_mul]
rw [hprod, hFK, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hnK, one_smul]

∀ β : Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) K (Chevalley.VK K M),
 (∀ (F : Module.End ℤ M) (f : Module.End ℂ V),
 (∀ u : Chevalley.MR p M, Chevalley.mu p M (F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p) u) = f (Chevalley.mu p M u)) →
 ∀ (i j : Chevalley.Index ell) (z : ℤ),
 f (Chevalley.e y v i.val) = (z : ℂ) • Chevalley.e y v j.val →
 F.baseChange K (β i) = (z : K) • β j) → ∀ i j : Chevalley.Index ell, (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧ Chevalley.matrixK K ell M x y i j = Chevalley.unitOp β i j
arguments.proof:
classical
intro β tr i j
obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h_T004.2.2.2.2.1
have hunit := (h_T006.2 b hb i j).1
have hnC : (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  simpa only [map_natCast] using (hunit.map (algebraMap (Chevalley.R p) ℂ)).ne_zero
have hnK : (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hc, ρ, hρ, hrest⟩ := h_T013
  simpa only [map_natCast] using (hunit.map ρ).ne_zero
refine ⟨hnK, ?_⟩
let F : Module.End ℤ M :=
  Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat - i.val)) *
    (Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat) * Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat)) *
      Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat - j.val))
let f : Module.End ℂ V :=
  Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat - i.val) *
    (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat) *
      Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat - j.val)
have hdx := fun r u => (h_T006.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 r u).1
have hdy := fun r u => (h_T006.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 r u).2
have hinter : ∀ u : Chevalley.MR p M,
    Chevalley.mu p M (F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p) u) = f (Chevalley.mu p M u) := by
  intro u
  simp only [F, f, LinearMap.baseChange_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hdx, hdy]
have hmat : f = (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : ℂ) • Chevalley.unitOp b i j := by
  rw [(h_T006.2 b hb i j).2.2.2.2.1, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hnC, one_smul]
have hFK : F.baseChange K = (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : K) • Chevalley.unitOp β i j := by
  apply β.ext
  intro k
  by_cases hk : k = j
  · subst k
    have he : f (Chevalley.e y v j.val) = (((Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (Chevalley.e y v i.val) := by
      rw [← hb j, ← hb i, hmat]
      simp [Chevalley.unitOp]
    have ht := tr F f hinter j i ((Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : ℕ) : ℤ) he
    simpa [Chevalley.unitOp] using ht
  · have he : f (Chevalley.e y v k.val) = (0 : ℂ) • Chevalley.e y v i.val := by
      rw [← hb k, hmat]
      simp [Chevalley.unitOp, hk]
    have ht := tr F f hinter k i 0 (by simpa using he)
    simpa [Chevalley.unitOp, hk] using ht
change (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : K)⁻¹ •
    (Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat-i.val)) *
      (Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat) * Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat)) *
        Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat-j.val))) = _
have hprod : Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat-i.val)) *
      (Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat) * Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat)) *
        Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat-j.val)) = F.baseChange K := by
  simp only [F, Chevalley.opK, LinearMap.baseChange_mul]
rw [hprod, hFK, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hnK, one_smul]

checked : ∀ (V : Type) [instV : AddCommGroup V] [instCV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (K : Type) [instK : Field K] (p : ℕ)
  (ell : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ ell ∧ ell < ↑p →
    0 < ell.toNat + 1 ∧
        Fintype.card (Chevalley.Index ell) = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
          Module.finrank ℂ V = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
            ((∀ (t : ℕ), h ((y ^ t) v) = (↑ell - 2 * ↑t) • (y ^ t) v) ∧
                ∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < t → x ((y ^ t) v) = (↑t * (↑ell - ↑t + 1)) • (y ^ (t - 1)) v) ∧
              (∃ b, ∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell), b i = Chevalley.e y v ↑i) ∧
                (∀ (t : ℕ), ell.toNat < t → (y ^ t) v = 0) ∧
                  Chevalley.stringActions ell x y h (Chevalley.e y v) ∧
                    Chevalley.dividedActions ell (Chevalley.dp x) (Chevalley.dp y) (Chevalley.e y v) →
      (((∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ Chevalley.R p ↔ ∃ a b, ¬↑p ∣ b ∧ q = ↑a / ↑b) ∧
            Function.Injective (Chevalley.mu p M) ∧
              Nonempty (Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) (↥(Chevalley.R p)) (Chevalley.MR p M)) ∧
                Submodule.span ℂ (Chevalley.image p M) = ⊤ ∧
                  (∀ (r : ℕ), Chevalley.inImage p M (Chevalley.dp x r) ∧ Chevalley.inImage p M (Chevalley.dp y r)) ∧
                    Chevalley.preserves M x ∧
                      Chevalley.preserves M y ∧
                        Chevalley.preserves M h ∧
                          ∀ (r : ℕ) (u : Chevalley.MR p M),
                            Chevalley.mu p M
                                  ((LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Chevalley.R p)) (Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp x r)))
                                    u) =
                                (Chevalley.dp x r) (Chevalley.mu p M u) ∧
                              Chevalley.mu p M
                                  ((LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Chevalley.R p)) (Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp y r)))
                                    u) =
                                (Chevalley.dp y r) (Chevalley.mu p M u)) ∧
          ∀ (b : Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) ℂ V),
            (∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell), b i = Chevalley.e y v ↑i) →
              ∀ (i j : Chevalley.Index ell),
                IsUnit ↑(ell.toNat.choose ↑j) ∧
                  Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat =
                      Chevalley.unitOp b (Fin.last ell.toNat) (Fin.last ell.toNat) ∧
                    Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat - ↑i) * (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat) =
                        Chevalley.unitOp b i (Fin.last ell.toNat) ∧
                      Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat - ↑j) =
                          ↑(ell.toNat.choose ↑j) • Chevalley.unitOp b (Fin.last ell.toNat) j ∧
                        Chevalley.unitOp b i j =
                            (↑(ell.toNat.choose ↑j))⁻¹ •
                              (Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat - ↑i) * (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat) *
                                Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat - ↑j)) ∧
                          Chevalley.inImage p M (Chevalley.unitOp b i j)) →
        (∃ b ∈ Chevalley.J p M y v 0,
            b ≠ 0 ∧
              Chevalley.J p M y v 0 = ↥(Chevalley.R p) ∙ b ∧
                (∀ (u : V),
                    u ∈ Chevalley.image p M ↔
                      ∃ c, u = ∑ i, (algebraMap ↥(Chevalley.R p) ℂ) (c i) • b • Chevalley.e y v ↑i) ∧
                  ∃ B,
                    ∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell),
                      Chevalley.mu p M (B i) = b • Chevalley.e y v ↑i ∧
                        ∀ (u : Chevalley.MR p M), Chevalley.mu p M u = b • Chevalley.e y v ↑i → u = B i) →
          Chevalley.reductions K p M →
            ∀ (β : Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) K (Chevalley.VK K M)),
              (∀ (F : Module.End ℤ ↥M) (f : Module.End ℂ V),
                  (∀ (u : Chevalley.MR p M),
                      Chevalley.mu p M ((LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Chevalley.R p)) F) u) = f (Chevalley.mu p M u)) →
                    ∀ (i j : Chevalley.Index ell) (z : ℤ),
                      f (Chevalley.e y v ↑i) = ↑z • Chevalley.e y v ↑j → (LinearMap.baseChange K F) (β i) = ↑z • β j) →

helper.statement:
∀ β : Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) K (Chevalley.VK K M),
 (∀ (F : Module.End ℤ M) (f : Module.End ℂ V),
 (∀ u : Chevalley.MR p M, Chevalley.mu p M (F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p) u) = f (Chevalley.mu p M u)) →
 ∀ (i j : Chevalley.Index ell) (z : ℤ),
 f (Chevalley.e y v i.val) = (z : ℂ) • Chevalley.e y v j.val →
 F.baseChange K (β i) = (z : K) • β j) → ∀ i j : Chevalley.Index ell, (Nat.choose ell.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧ Chevalley.matrixK K ell M x y i j = Chevalley.unitOp β i j
helper.application: @yui_aux_0014 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_T004 h_T006 h_T012 h_T013
helper.scope: Checked same-node theorem; available in later checks and the final body.

arguments.statement: ∀ W : Submodule K (Chevalley.VK K M), Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.opK K M x) → Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.opK K M y) → ∀ i j, Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.matrixK K ell M x y i j)
arguments.proof:
intro W hx hy
have hp (f : Module.End K (Chevalley.VK K M)) (hf : Chevalley.stable W f) :
    ∀ r : ℕ, Chevalley.stable W (f ^ r) := by
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    intro w hw
    simpa using hw
  | succ r ih =>
    intro w hw
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]
    exact ih _ (hf _ hw)
have hsm (a : K) (f : Module.End K (Chevalley.VK K M)) (hf : Chevalley.stable W f) :
    Chevalley.stable W (a • f) := by
  intro w hw
  exact W.smul_mem a (hf w hw)
have hmul (f g : Module.End K (Chevalley.VK K M))
    (hf : Chevalley.stable W f) (hg : Chevalley.stable W g) : Chevalley.stable W (f*g) := by
  intro w hw
  exact hf _ (hg w hw)
have hfact := @yui_aux_0013 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_T004 h_T006 h_T012 h_T013
have hX (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ ell.toNat) : Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x r)) := by
  rw [(hfact r hr).2.1]
  exact hsm _ _ (hp _ hx r)
have hY (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ ell.toNat) : Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y r)) := by
  rw [(hfact r hr).2.2]
  exact hsm _ _ (hp _ hy r)
intro i j
unfold Chevalley.matrixK
apply hsm
apply hmul
· exact hmul _ _ (hX _ (Nat.sub_le _ _)) (hmul _ _ (hY _ le_rfl) (hX _ le_rfl))
· exact hY _ (Nat.sub_le _ _)
